title: When Is an Agent Evaluation Over? Outcome Finality and Cross-Unit Separation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14940v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current agent evaluations score models on the state visible at the end of a stopped run which they count as one trial. However, interpreting the score as a final result would require two conditions that the endpoint does not itself necessarily establish: outcome finality and cross-unit separation. These conditions are independent, since reconciling a delayed outcome can settle the label while runs still share state and isolating runs can prevent carryover while the scored outcome remains unfinished. We develop a completion argument that specifies the evidence needed for each decision and argue that a final label is justified only when anything that could still change the claimed outcome is resolved, bounded, or retained as uncertainty. translated_title: 智能体评估何时结束？结果终局性与跨单元分离
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14940v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：当前的智能体评估在停止运行的终点状态上对模型进行评分，并将其视为一次试验。然而，将评分解释为最终结果需要两个终点本身不一定建立的条件：结果终局性和跨单元分离。这两个条件是独立的，因为协调延迟结果可以解决标签，而运行仍共享状态；隔离运行可以防止遗留效应，但评分结果仍未完成。我们开发了一个完成论证，指定了每个决策所需的证据，并认为只有当任何可能改变所声称结果的事物被解决、限制或保留为不确定性时，最终标签才是合理的。首先，在受控重放中，我们固定智能体的动作以演示该机制，发现终点和终局标签在每次延迟操作中都有差异，而延迟写入
tldr: 该论文提出智能体评估的终局性条件，强调只有当所有可能改变结果的因素被解决或明确限制时，评估标签才可靠，并通过受控实验展示了延迟操作导致的终点与终局标签差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes outcome finality conditions for agent evaluations, arguing that final labels are justified only when all factors that could change results are resolved or bounded, and demonstrates via controlled replay that delayed operations cause endpoint and finality label discrepancies.
